_comment: Cards the price engine snapshots nightly — the watchlist's source of truth, and the feed behind the on-page Prospect Signal Board. SCOPE DECISION (Jun 26 2026): for baseball prospects we track ONE canonical card per player = the 1st Bowman Chrome AUTO. Fallback: if a prospect had NO auto in their first Bowman, track the 1st Bowman Chrome BASE instead and set cardType:"chrome-base". BOARD scope stays Chrome / Chrome Auto only. SAPPHIRE ADDENDUM (Aug 31 2026, Mo): Sapphire cards the SITE invites people to track (bowman-sapphire-2026 page) get their own boardHide feeds so the Vault links them to SAPPHIRE prices, never Chrome proxies; all chrome queries carry -sapphire so the board medians stay pure. VAULT-DRIVEN ADDITIONS (Aug 11 2026): cards Mo owns/hunts may be added so the Vault can link them to live pricing, even outside the 2026 CPA class — set boardHide:true so they stay OFF the /bowman-bangers Signal Board (board stays 2026-class only). Exact card the vault holds, not a proxy. CARD CODES (Sep 3 2026, Mo: the price must be THIS card): every chrome-auto query carries its card code (CPA-XX) and the engine requires that code in the listing title, so a signed base card (BCP-45), a Mega Box auto (BMA-SK) or a 2025 Draft auto can never price a 1st Bowman Chrome Auto.
_engine: ZERO-SECRET PATH (Jul 31 2026): the nightly snapshot runs as a GitHub Action (.github/workflows/price-snapshot.yml) and prices each card off the site's own public /api/comps endpoint (eBay Browse, already live on Vercel) — no tokens anywhere. Each card's `query` is the eBay search used to mark it nightly (trimmed median of the lowest fixed-price asks). `id` is a stable slug; feed rows are keyed source:id, e.g. ebay:ethan-holliday. Ranks mirror the Jul 28 editorial re-rank on /bowman-bangers.

_schema.id: string — stable slug (free path) or product id (paid path)
_schema.label: string — human name for display
_schema.query: string — eBay search terms for the free path
_schema.condition: loose | graded | psa10 | new | cib (paid path only)
_schema.cardType: chrome-auto (default) | chrome-base (no-auto fallback) | single (Sep 21 2026, idea #30: a non-Bowman sports single — verifier default path, no auto/chrome requirement, no slug until the block generators can name its set) | tcg-single (Pokemon etc: no auto requirement, TCG noise filter) | sealed (Sep 13 2026: one flagship sealed product per set index — booster box, or the ETB where the set has no booster box; titleMust carries the product words; TITLE_BAD_SEALED in the engine; never blended with singles)
_schema.slug: optional — site page this card links back to
_schema.rank: optional integer — editorial rank if it's a featured top-10 card (else omit)
_schema.titleMust: optional string[] — tokens that must ALL appear in a listing title (overrides last-name check). Use card numbers (161/131) for TCG.
_schema.categoryIds: optional — eBay category override for /api/comps. 183454 = CCG Individual Cards (Pokemon). Default 212 = Sports Trading Cards.
_schema.sealedOf: optional — for cardType sealed: the index ticker this product belongs to (PB26 …); the index page renders it as the SEALED row
_schema.product: optional — for cardType sealed: the product name shown on-page (Booster box | Elite Trainer Box)
